heroHeadline: Pakistan detains hundreds of PTI members as protests falter amid KP emergency rule
heroSubtitle: After PTI-government talks collapsed on Oct 4 and a long march toward Islamabad began, the federal government imposed emergency and governor's rule in KP on Oct 11, authorising army deployment. Police say CM Sohail Afridi and seven other PTI leaders are in protective custody; PTI calls it unconstitutional.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major Pakistani news outlets, and institutional analyses.
